name: kaudit-platform
description: Kairali Voice Agent Call Audit & Billing Platform — decoupled audit application (separate from the KCRM app; connects to the same MySQL kaudit_* tables).

scripts.check: npm run secrets:scan && npm run typecheck && npm run web:typecheck && npm run web:build && npm test
scripts.test:w1: node --test src/identity/resolveIdentity.test.ts src/identity/buildUserSet.test.ts src/identity/access.test.ts src/identity/oidcBinding.test.ts src/adapters/mysqlOidcBinding.test.ts src/audit/transactionalAuditWriter.test.ts src/cli/runOidcBindCli.test.ts
scripts.test:callaudit: node --test src/callaudit/*.test.ts src/adapters/mysqlCallAuditSource.test.ts src/adapters/mysqlCallAuditPersistence.test.ts src/adapters/mysqlCallAuditControl.test.ts src/adapters/mysqlCallAuditReporting.test.ts src/adapters/mysqlCallAuditSettings.test.ts src/adapters/openaiCallAuditModel.test.ts src/adapters/openaiCallAuditClient.test.ts src/cli/runSecureDashboardCallAudit.test.ts src/cli/runCallAuditBatchCli.test.ts src/reporting/callAuditReport.test.ts src/reporting/callAuditReportArtifacts.test.ts src/reporting/callAuditWebContract.test.ts src/reporting/callAuditSettingsWebContract.test.ts src/http/enterpriseDashboardServer.callAudit.test.ts src/http/enterpriseDashboardServer.callAuditSettings.test.ts src/http/enterpriseDashboardServer.callAuditRuleTest.test.ts
scripts.test:ui: node --test src/ui/metrics.test.ts src/ui/render.test.ts src/ui/decimal.test.ts src/ui/periods.test.ts src/ui/fullDashboard.test.ts src/ui/fullRender.test.ts
scripts.app:dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c cyan,green "KAUDIT_SECURE_PORT=4175 npm run ui:secure" "npm run web:dev"
scripts.app:dev:secure: concurrently -k -n api,web -c cyan,green "KAUDIT_SECURE_PORT=4175 npm run ui:secure" "npm run web:dev"
scripts.app:preview: npm run web:build && KAUDIT_AUTH_MODE=preview KAUDIT_SECURE_PORT=4176 npm run ui:secure
scripts.app:start: npm run web:build && npm run ui:secure
scripts.app:operate: npm run web:build && concurrently -k -n api,audit,report -c cyan,magenta,yellow "npm run ui:secure" "KAUDIT_AUDIT_MODE=EXECUTE KAUDIT_AUDIT_BATCH=10 KAUDIT_AUDIT_WATCH=true npm run audit:worker" "KAUDIT_REPORT_EMAIL_WATCH=true npm run report:email-worker"
